name: Umineko no Naku Koro ni
source:
Umineko no Naku Koro ni takes place primarily in the year 1986, during the time frame of October 4 and October 5 on a small, secluded island named Rokkenjima (六軒島) owned and lived on by [url=/c200]Kinzo[/url], the head of the wealthy Ushiromiya family. Kinzo is expected to pass soon due to his age, and so his 4 children and their families arrive on the island to discuss how Kinzo's assets will be divided after his death for the annual family conference. But when a typhoon hits the island, a ghastly game begins, starting with the murder of six people and the discovery of a letter signed by Beatrice, the island's golden witch of legend, beckoning the family to solve her epitaph and find the island's hidden gold before it is too late.

[Edited from [url=https://wiki.whentheycry.org/wiki/Umineko_no_Naku_Koro_ni/]When They Cry Wiki[/url]]
translation:
《海猫鸣泣之时》的故事主要发生在1986年10月4日至5日。舞台是远离尘世的小岛六轩岛（六軒島），这里归富有的右代宫家族家主[url=/c200]金藏[/url]所有，也是他的居所。年事已高的金藏被认为已时日无多，于是他的四名子女携家人登岛参加一年一度的家族会议，商议金藏去世后的遗产分配。然而，台风袭击岛屿后，一场骇人的游戏拉开帷幕。最初的六人遇害，随后众人发现了一封署名“贝阿朵莉切”的信。她正是传说中居住在岛上的黄金魔女。信中要求右代宫家族在一切为时已晚之前解开她的碑文之谜，找到隐藏在岛上的黄金。

[改写自[url=https://wiki.whentheycry.org/wiki/Umineko_no_Naku_Koro_ni/]When They Cry Wiki[/url]]
